text:
maria: FYI I opened a short PR that changes how logprobs are reported when a stop sequence truncates generation. Before we included logprobs for tokens up to max_tokens even if generation stopped earlier; now the runtime trims logprobs to only emitted tokens. Want to confirm this is the intended API contract and call out backward-compatibility.
jasper: can you paste a minimal request/response that changed?
maria: sure — example below (repro in staging):
```
POST /v1/generate
{ "prompt": "Hello\n", "max_tokens": 10, "stop": ["\n"], "logprobs": 5 }
```
old response: returned logprobs array length == 10 (padded/nulls)
new response: logprobs array length == tokens emitted (2) — which matches actual outputs but breaks clients expecting fixed-length arrays
jasper: that sounds cleaner semantically. Clients relying on fixed-size arrays need a migration path though.
simon: we should not silently break Hosted API. Proposal: add a response header `x-rw-logprobs-style: trimmed|padded` and a compat query param `logprobs_padding=legacy` that preserves old behavior for now.
alice: +1 on header + opt-in param. Also update SDKs to normalize (e.g., pad with nulls on client side) in next minor release. We should document exact semantics: trimmed -> length == emitted tokens; padded -> length == max_tokens.
maria: good, I'll update the PR. Two extra notes: streaming mode currently emits logprobs per chunk; we need to ensure streaming chunks don't duplicate/truncate when stop arrives. Jasper can you check streaming codepath?
jasper: on it. Also flag on temp/top_p interplay: sampling randomness can cause early stop tokens to vary; logprobs for prefix+stop tokens should reflect chosen sampling. Need to add e2e that asserts logprob array aligns with returned tokens under stochastic sampling.
eng-ops-bot: NOTE: Dedicated customers with strict contracts detected. Alerting product and legal for review.
simon: rollout plan: (1) add compat param + header, (2) ship to staging behind feature flag, (3) one-week notice to customers, (4) SDK patch to handle both styles, (5) flip feature flag after 30 days.
maria: I'll add unit tests for: stop-truncation, truncated logprobs in non-streaming, streaming boundary where stop arrives mid-chunk, and temp/top_p e2e runs. I'll also add an entry in the API changelog draft and ping @product.
alice: small UX ask — should we provide a convenience `logprobs_alignment: "tokens"|"max_tokens"` in the JSON body instead of query param? Both okay but query param is easier for SDKs to opt into.
simon: query param is fine for compat; we can add JSON field in the next major if needed.
maria: action items assigned in PR description. tagging reviewers: @jasper @simon @alice. ping me on code review for quick turnaround.
jasper: quick verification: also ensure embeddings/ rerank endpoints that accept `max_tokens` are unaffected.
maria: yup will include a checklist. :thumbsup:
